name: Enfeeblement
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Choose a creature within medium range and roll Spirit vs. Spirit. On a win, any time the creature rolls Strength, halve the result, and any time they deal damage with an attack made by rolling Strength, halve the damage. On a loss, they take -1d to Strength rolls.

Describe the effects of the curse.
successes:
✨: You may sustain the spell for 1 additional minute.

🌞: On a win, repeat the halving a second time in both cases. On a loss, same effect as a normal win.
